reason: My Instagram guy already shows me pictures and prices in Arabic and I just pay him the deposit. I don't know how to search Taobao or 1688 myself, and most of what I want I can find in the Baghdad market today anyway.
objection: It's a new name and I have to pay the item price up front to people I've never dealt with. 21,000 on top of a 30,000 item is a lot, and car parts are heavy, so the per-kilo shipping adds up fast.
would_change_my_mind: If someone I know ordered through them and got the item on time, and they helped me find the link myself through WhatsApp instead of me searching Chinese sites.
